notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-20, cited below. Polish Wikipedia, Armia „Lublin” (R2287, tertiary), and 1939.pl on the first battle of Tomaszów Lubelski (R2288) agree that the army surrendered on 20 September 1939 at Tomaszów Lubelski. A more specific headquarters in the village of Zielone on 19 September is named by 1939.pl but was not entered, because a reliable coordinate for that Zielone was not in hand. Formation-day sources disagree (3 or 4 September), so no opening-day location was invented. Confidence is capped at 0.5.
